Publish.LongDescription:
# Static Scenery Ploppables
**English** | 中文见下方
Plop any vanilla zoned building exactly as it looks in your city - then keep only the looks. Every placement looks exactly like a real zoned building - the same building with its properties stripped: same model, same lot, same decorations, zero simulation.
**What it does** - Browse 2000+ vanilla zoned buildings in one panel: search, tabs for residential / mixed housing / commercial / office / industrial, and filters for style (European / North American), density, level, width and depth. - Every placement rolls its own decoration variant with the game's own randomization: no two scenes are identical. - The result is a pure shell: no residents, no jobs, no households, no companies, no simulation cost.
**Why it's different** - Static-Ploppables-style mods hand you the building shell and nothing else. Here you also get the vanilla lot surface and the randomized decorations the game itself would spawn - trees, benches, planters, bins, light poles, parking-lot details. The result looks lived-in instead of empty. - It is the very same building you see when the zone grows: a working building and a scenery piece look identical; the only difference is that one has properties and the other does not.
**Compatibility and safety** - The vanilla relocate tool and bulldozing behave exactly as they do with real buildings. - Uninstall-safe (verified): the save still loads and does not crash. Placed objects become missing-prefab placeholders (white models) and can be bulldozed together with their decorations. - No dependencies. Works alongside Find It, Move It, Anarchy and ctrlC.
**Localization**: panel text follows your game language - English, Simplified/Traditional Chinese, German, French, Spanish, Portuguese (BR), Russian, Polish, Japanese, Korean. Other languages fall back to English.
**Source & feedback**: https://github.com/LiangHaoXiang/StaticSceneryPloppables

# 静态造景建筑
把**任意原版分区建筑**原样放进城市，只留下外观。 每次放置的都是一栋与真实的分区建筑一致外观的建筑，只是**属性被剥离**：模型一样、地皮一样、装饰一样，不产生任何模拟。
**它做什么** - 在一个面板里浏览 2000+ 原版分区建筑：搜索、类型页签（住宅 / 混合型住宅 / 商业 / 办公 / 工业），以及按风格（欧美 / 北美）、密度、等级、面宽、进深的筛选。 - 每次摆放用游戏自身的随机逻辑抽一份装饰方案，没有两处完全相同。 - 结果是纯净外壳：没有居民、没有岗位、没有住户与公司、不产生模拟开销。
**与 Static Ploppables 类模组的不同** - 那类模组给你的只是**建筑外壳**；这里还额外带上**原版地皮**与**游戏随机生成的装饰**——树木、长椅、花盆、垃圾箱、灯杆、停车场细节，场景是「有人住过」的样子，而不是空壳。 - 它就是你平时分区长出来的那栋楼本身——真实建筑与造景件**外观完全一致**，区别只在于一个有属性、一个没有。
**兼容与安全** - 原版迁移与拆除操作都和对真实建筑操作的结果一致。 - 卸载安全（实测）：移除模组后存档能正常载入、不崩溃；摆放物变成白模占位，用推土机拆除白模时装饰一并清除。 - 无前置依赖，可与 Find It / Move It / Anarchy / ctrlC 共存。
**语言支持**：面板文案跟随游戏语言——English、简体/繁体中文、德文、法文、西班牙文、葡萄牙文（BR）、俄文、波兰文、日文、韩文；其余语言回退英文。
**源码与反馈**：https://github.com/LiangHaoXiang/StaticSceneryPloppables

ChangeLog.Value: 0.1.6: UI fixes - the panel close button is now white and matches the vanilla filter panel size, and Escape closes the panel again (it now claims the game Back action like Find It, so it also no longer opens the pause menu). 0.1.5: performance & polish - the panel background no longer uses a backdrop blur (measured 5-6 fps drop with blur, now 0), the panel looks cleaner with better text contrast; UI debug logging reduced to a single clear line; unused localization entries removed. 0.1.4: new panel features - a separate Mixed Housing tab (pure residential vs mixed-use), a Style filter (European / North American) above Density, and an 8-level catalog ordering (zone, density, area, width, depth, level, signature, name). 0.1.3: performance update - catalog build time 6.0s -> 3.6s (3397 -> 2077 prefabs, levels 2/4 are no longer built), package size 166 KB -> 74 KB (no pdb), the whole catalog is pushed to the UI once (search and filters now run instantly in the panel), orphan-lot cleanup removed (placement and relocation share the same engine pipeline); fixed a stray UI event warning in the log. 0.1.2: fix - the UI bundle (.mjs + images) is now guaranteed to be inside the package; without it the toolbar entry and panel were missing. 0.1.1: metadata update (bilingual description). 0.1.0: first public build - full vanilla zoned building catalog, Find It-style panel with search/zone/density/level/size filters, lot surfaces and randomized vanilla decorations, 11-language UI.
